lesson.title: Critics and criticism
lesson.title_ar: القسم الأدبي (6): النُّقّاد والنقد الفني (Critics and Criticism)

lines: ARTS 6   Critics and criticism
Professional critics of the arts

Why do you watch one film and not another? Why do you buy one compact disc and not another? Perhaps a friend recommended them, and, of course, you have your own personal taste. However, your opinions and tastes as well as your friend's may have been influenced by critics.

The verb ' to criticize' means to make a judgement about something or somebody. A critic is a person who makes judgements about the arts, that is literature, sculpture, films, music, television programmes and so on. The critic helps the public to decide whether a new book or film, for example, is good.
The reports that critics write are called ' reviews'. After people read reviews they decide whether they want to buy a particular compact disc or watch a particular video.
Making judgements

Critics comment on works of art in many ways. In poetry, the critic looks at the language the poet uses and how well this expresses what he or she wants to say. When discussing a painting, one critic may describe only the technique - how the artist painted the picture. Some critics think that the artist's life is important. One film critic will talk about how interesting the story of the film is; another will concentrate on how it was filmed; another may comment only on the acting.
The importance of critics

Critics are important in two ways. First, they can have an immediate effect on the success of a work of art. If a film gets bad reviews, people might not want to see it. Secondly, critics draw the attention of the public to new works.
Critics help us have a better understanding of the arts. However, they cannot tell us what to think. In the end, we have to make up our own minds.
Other uses of critic, criticism, criticize and critical
1 Ahmed has his critics. = There are some people who say that Ahmed does everything wrong.
2 The new building got a lot of criticism. = A lot of people didn't like the new building.
3 Stop criticizing me. = Stop saying I do everything wrong.
4 Ahmed is a very critical person. = Ahmed criticizes things or other people a lot.
or
The game has reached a critical stage. = The game has reached a very important stage.
Discussion:
• Do you use your own judgement to choose books and videos, or do you wait to hear what other people or critics say?
• Do you agree that critics do a useful job?

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي ودلالية (PB p. 57 & WB p. 90):
1) حُفظت المسافة المطبوعة بعد علامة التنصيص في ' to criticize' و' reviews'، كما حُفظ خطأ التصريف في ذيل تمرين الكتابة WB Arts 6 E: a film you have just see. (see بدل seen).
2) انتبه إلى المعنيين المزدوجين للصفة critical في الصندوق: «كثير الانتقاد/التجريح» مع الأشخاص، و«حرج / شديد الأهمية» مع المراحل (a critical stage).

interactive_spot.label: عائلة الكلمة (critic family) والفرق بين النقد الفني والذم اليومي

simple_explain.html:
• الاسم للفاعل (critic): ناقد فني (يمدح أو يذم بحكم موضوعي)، أو ناقد لوم في الاستعمال اليومي.
  • الاسم غير المعدود للعمل/الموقف (criticism): نقد/مآخذ.
  • الفعل (criticize): يُصدر حكماً فنياً على عمل إبداعي، أو ينتقد خطأً.
  • الصفة (critical): كثير النقد للناس / حاسم وخطير للموقف (a critical stage).

example.html: Common trap (WB 6 A #1): In everyday talk, criticizing means finding fault; for arts professionals in PB p. 57, to criticize means to make a judgement (either good or bad).

activities.prompt_literal: ARTS 6 A Read the paragraph 'Professional critics of the arts'. Are these statements true or false? Write T or F.
activities.prompt_ar: حدّد صحة (T) أو خطأ (F) كل عبارة عن فقرة النقاد المحترفين (WB ص 89):

items.prompt: 1 To criticize a piece of art means to say it is bad. ______
3 We buy compact discs which taste good. ______

hints: العبارات الأربع كلها خاطئة (F): 1 يعني إصدار حكم (قد يكون إيجابياً أو سلبياً)، 2 يشمل الأدب والنحت والأفلام والموسيقى إلخ، 3 المقصود الذوق الشخصي personal taste لا مذاق الطعام، 4 يكتبون تقارير (reports) لا كتباً.

activities.prompt_literal: B Read the paragraph 'Making judgements'. Complete the table with words from the text.
activities.prompt_ar: أكمل أعمدة جدول معايير النقد الثلاثة في 6 B بكلمات من فقرة 'Making judgements' (WB ص 89):

items.question: Poetry criticism is about ... (2 items in text)
items.model_answer: 1) the language the poet uses; 2) how well this expresses what he or she wants to say.
items.explain_ar: الجملة الثانية في فقرة Making judgements.

items.question: Art criticism is about... (2 items in text)
items.model_answer: 1) the technique - how the artist painted the picture; 2) the artist's life.
items.explain_ar: الجملتان الثالثة والرابعة في نفس الفقرة.

items.question: Film criticism is about... (3 items matching 3 table rows)
items.model_answer: 1) how interesting the story of the film is; 2) how it was filmed; 3) the acting.
items.explain_ar: تضمّ الجملة الأخيرة ثلاثة عناصر تطابق الصفوف الثلاثة في الجدول.

hints: نقد الشعر ونقد الرسم يشغلان صفّين بينما يملأ نقد السينما الصفوف الثلاثة جميعها.

activities.prompt_literal: C Read the paragraph 'The importance of critics'. Why are critics important to these people?
activities.prompt_ar: علّل أهمية النُّقّاد للفئات الثلاث اعتماداً على فقرة 'The importance of critics' (WB ص 89):

items.question: 1 film-makers
items.model_answer: Critics can have an immediate effect on the success of a work of art (if a film gets bad reviews, people might not want to see it).
items.explain_ar: النقد يؤثر مباشرة في إقبال الجمهور ونجاح الفيلم.

items.question: 2 new artists
items.model_answer: Critics draw the attention of the public to new works.
items.explain_ar: لفت أنظار الناس إلى المواهب والأعمال الجديدة.

items.question: 3 the general public
items.model_answer: Critics help us have a better understanding of the arts and help people decide whether a new book, CD or film is good (though we make up our own minds in the end).

hints: استند إلى الفقرة الثالثة كاملة في PB ص 57.

activities.prompt_literal: D Complete these sentences with words from the text.
activities.prompt_ar: أكمل الجمل الخمس بكلمات مناسبة من نص PB ص 57 (WB ص 90):

items.prompt: 1 Some people choose a book only if a friend ______ it.
2 Some poetry critics look at the ideas in a ______ ; (first blank)
... others concentrate on how the poet ______ those ideas.
3 A critic ______ the public's attention to new works (first blank)
4 We each have our own ______ in music, films and so on.
5 The most important point for some art critics is the ______ of the artist - how well he/she paints.

hints: انتبه للتصريف الصحيح للأفعال المفردة بالمضارع البسيط: recommends, expresses, draws.

activities.prompt_literal: E Write a short review of a book you have just read, or a film you have just see. Say whether you liked it or not, and why.
activities.prompt_ar: ورشة كتابة مراجعة نقدية قصيرة (review) لكتاب أو فيلم (WB ص 90):
activities.guidance_literal: Title & topic -> Technique / story / language -> Personal judgement & recommendation

steps.label_ar: مراجعة قصيرة نموذجية (تم الحفاظ على الصيغة المطبوعة 'have just see' في السؤال)
steps.placeholder: I recently read the short story episode about Telford Hall and really enjoyed it. The story is interesting because it blends humour with cultural details about Ramadan and Eid in Britain, and the writer uses clear, vivid language. In the end, I would strongly recommend it to other students.

hints: تذكّر توظيف أسباب النقد من جدول 6 B (القصة، اللغة، الأسلوب/التقنية) وحكمك الخاص.

questions.stem: In PB page 57, what is the difference in meaning between 'Ahmed is a very critical person' and 'The game has reached a critical stage'?

options.text: For a person it means criticizing a lot; for a stage it means very important / decisive.
Both mean writing professional film reviews for newspapers.
options.why_wrong: الاستخدامان في صندوق 4 يخرجان عن النقد الصحفي إلى معاني النقد الشخصي والخطورة.

options.text: Both mean Ahmed lost the football match.
options.why_wrong: لم يذكر خسارة أي مباراة بل أن المرحلة أصبحت مهمة للغاية.

options.text: The first is a noun and the second is a verb.
options.why_wrong: كلاهما الصفة critical في جملتين مختلفتين دلالياً.

hints: انظر البند 4 داخل الصندوق البرتقالي على PB ص 57.
questions.explain: تدل الصفة critical مع الناس على كثرة النقد واللوم، بينما تدل مع stage على مرحلة حساسة ومهمة جداً.

questions.stem: Why are all four statements in WB Arts 6 A ('To criticize... bad / The arts means painting / CDs taste good / Critics write books called reviews') FALSE?

options.text: Because criticizing means judging broadly, the arts cover many forms, personal taste means likes/dislikes, and reviews are reports.
Because critics only write novels about science.
options.why_wrong: يكتب النقاد تقارير تسمى reviews عن الفنون بأنواعها.

options.text: Because films never receive bad reviews.
options.why_wrong: ينص النص على أن الأفلام قد تتلقى مراجعات سيئة (bad reviews).

options.text: Because poetry critics cannot comment on language.
options.why_wrong: بل ينظر نقاد الشعر إلى لغة الشاعر ومدى تعبيرها.

hints: راجع تصويب كل جملة من الجمل الأربع في WB ص 89.
questions.explain: كل واحدة من العبارات الأربع غيرت تعريفاً صريحاً في فقرة Professional critics of the arts فكانت خطأ.
